messages:
sre-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — API GW 502/504 spike detected. Error rate on apigw-prod (us-west-2) jumped to ~18% over the last 3m, increased latency on edge nodes. Pager routed to @aj (oncall).

oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-8943 created and notified: high error-rate - apigw (sev2).

aj: I’m on it. Shifting to #incidents for triage. Visible across multiple edge clusters; start with routing and recent deploys.

maria: Nothing on deploys in last 30m from release logs. No config rollouts either.

devon: Confirming, deploys show last at 2323420000 (health check minor bump). Not matching timeframe.

lucy: Quick customer impact check: internal metrics show failed requests for text-gen endpoints up 20%, embeddings ~5%. Some customers seeing elevated 5xx.

thomas: Graphs: per-route 502s spiking most for /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream. Also seeing increased connect timeouts to backend pool.

aj: Can someone run a curl sample to reproduce and capture headers? Need example request/response.

maria: Ran curl from us-west-2 bastion: ```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (10.0.0.23) port 443 (#0)
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< x-edge-node: edge-usw2-11
< x-upstream: backend-gpu-42:5222
< content-type: application/json
{ \"error\": \"upstream: connection reset\" }
```

devon: Logs show repeated `connection reset by peer` from a subset of upstreams. Kernel logs on backend-gpu-42 show OOM events around the spike time.

aj: Interesting. Could be overloaded backend causing TCP resets. What’s autoscaler doing?

lucy: Autoscaler metrics: instance provisioning delayed (~90s) due to limited capacity in that AZ; queued requests built up.

thomas: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) Route traffic away from affected edge nodes via traffic-split (route to other regions) 2) Temporarily increase retry attempts with jitter at gateway 3) Add quick backend mask rule to prefer healthy upstream group.

maria: For short-term, I can push a routing policy to remove edge-usw2-1..3 from LB pool. Minimal config change, revertable. Thoughts?

aj: Do it. Also enable a 3s connect timeout to fail fast and let retries handle routing. Keep retries conservative to avoid thundering herd: 2 retries with exponential backoff.

oncall-bot: Action assigned: @maria — remove edge-usw2 nodes from LB. ETA 2m. @aj — adjust gateway retry/connect settings.

maria: Pushed removal rule to apigw-ctrl: `route remove edge-usw2-[1-3]` — applied. Monitoring now.

thomas: I’m toggling gateway connect timeout to 3s and retries=2 on apigw-prod via config flag `apigw.timeout.connect=3000` and `apigw.retries.max=2`. Deploying in 1m.

devon: After routing change, 502 rate dropped to ~6% in the next 90s. Latency improved slightly. Backend errors still present but localized.

lucy: Noticed a set of customers (ids: cust-12, cust-87) saw degraded SLAs during the spike. Product wants a quick summary for customer-facing comms. @product-sig can you draft?

product-sig: On it. Need timeline and ETA for RCA. Please send brief notes: start time, impact scope, mitigations taken.

aj: Timeline: spike start ~2323456700, pager at 2323456789, routing change at 2323456900, gateway config at 2323457000. Impact: increased 502/504s primarily on text-gen routes; peak error rate ~18%; reduced to ~4-6% after mitigations.

maria: Followup: we found 2 backend instances with repeated OOM and kernel restarts — suspected bad batch workload on gpu-42 and gpu-43. Those instances were cordoned and replaced by autoscaler; capacity delays were due to AZ limits.

thomas: Next steps while oncall: 1) run deeper mem/cgroup audit on affected hosts 2) add temporary capacity reservation in west cluster 3) prepare rollback path for recent model-runner changes if correlated.

aj: For immediate handoff: I’ll stay for 15m to ensure stability, then hand to @devon for monitoring and RCA lead. @devon you good to own RCA?

devon: I’ll take RCA. Will pull pcap, kernel logs, model-runner traces, and correlate with customer traffic.

lucy: Noting customer comms: product-sig will draft a short message for impacted customers; engineering to provide a blameless summary and ETA for full RCA in 24-48h.

oncall-bot: Incident PD-8943 status updated: mitigated -> partial, awaiting RCA.

maria: Leaving a short runbook note: if OOM pattern repeats, cordon node, scale up reserve pool, and set ephemeral circuit-breaker on heavy routes.

aj: Thanks all. I’m unpaged at 2323460200 — leaving monitoring to @devon.

devon: Acknowledged, will watch for 1h and start RCA doc.

product-sig: Drafted customer note and putting it in #customer-comms for review. ETA 30m.

sre-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated) — final status: partial impact, targeted mitigation applied. Please file RCA issue and link to this thread.

lucy: Filing RCA ticket now (ENG-9812). I’ll attach logs and timeline.

thomas: Quick action items: 1) add AZ capacity alert 2) evaluate autoscaler retry/backoff config 3) review model-runner memory patterns.

aj: Great work team. Quick retrospective: quick routing removal + fast retries avoided larger customer outage. Followups in RCA. :thumbsup:
